summary: Plains All American Pipeline LP (PAA) completed the sale of its Canadian NGL business (Plains Midstream Canada ULC) to Keyera Corp. for CAD $5.13B (~USD $3.76B) in cash, netting ~$3.3B after taxes/expenses. The sale, under a June 2025 SPA, will reduce leverage via debt repayment (commercial paper, term loan, 4.50% notes due 2026). Board recommended the deal; no advisor named. The transaction closed with transition services agreements. Watch for post-closing adjustments and leverage reduction impact; risk-arb angle minimal as cash deal closed.
